notes: Symptoms: at the parent 709e68b, fetch_contest_streak refuses to write a current activeStreak: a None source_date hits _fail('profile proves no settled result date; refusing to claim freshness') and a source_date two or more settled picks behind the latest resolved pick hits _fail in the currentness gate; _fail raises SystemExit(2), which the profile try's exception tuple does not catch, so CliRunner reports exit code 2. (1) test_fetch_cli_persists_snapshot_when_no_settled_predictions (no settled predictions, derive_source_date None) fails at line 216; (2) TestFetchContestStreak::test_genuinely_stale_profile_still_writes_snapshot (source_date 2026-06-01, four newer resolved picks) fails at line 819. The exit-code assertion is the first one after the command runs; the refusal it catches is the defect, and the persistence assertion on the next line is not reached. Static checks: cli.py differs P..F only by 4bdfdb8's removal of the None _fail and the gate (contest_fetch.py by 9a3e8ed's build_observation change), so every patched name and call shape is the same at the parent. Anchors at 4bdfdb8: 'assert res.exit_code == 0, res.output' at lines 198 and 216 of tests/test_contest_fetch.py; 'assert r.exit_code == 0, r.output' at 777, 819, 842, 966, 980 of tests/test_cli_integration.py. Not declared: test_fetch_cli_persists_current_activestreak_despite_lag and test_expected_settlement_lag_writes_snapshot_no_alert (the observed one-step lag) fail at the parent with FileNotFoundError (the gate exits 0 without writing contest_streak.json); test_build_observation_allows_none_source_date fails with ContestFetchError('source_date is required'). Lead's review: dropped test_build_observation_allows_none_source_date, test_fetch_cli_persists_current_activestreak_despite_lag from the selection: each fails at the parent only because of a name, field or keyword the fix added (new API), never by assertion, and adds nothing to the replay.
